senses.gloss:
Upendra
--Antyeṣṭiprayoga. Baroda 10952 (f).
--Āruṇaketukacayanapradīpikā. Baroda 2589. IL. 207 (II).
--Āruṇaketukaprayoga. IL. 207 (I). Probably same a. the previous.
--Patnīsaṁskāravivecana. BISM. v.. 868. from the next.
--Pitṛmedhaprayogadīpikā BISM. v.. 868. C.. Antyeṣṭiprayoga above.

Upendra
son of Rāma Bhaṭṭa, pupil of Vyaṅku Śāstrin; wrote a. the request of Nāgeśa Dīkṣita, a Kāṇva.
--Suparṇacitidīpikā. Alwar 220. Extr. 64. Peters. II. 174. PUL. I. p. 136.

Upendra
teacher of Vādīndra (a. of Guruguṇastava). Mysore II. p. 9. Trav. Uni. 3141.

Upendra
--C. on Neminirvāṇa Kāvya of Vāgbhaṭa. CPB. 7514-7523.

Upendra_Adhvarin
--Smṛtiśekhara. Mysore I. p. 139.

Upendracakra
jy. Adyar II. p. 53a.

Upendradatta
--Pañcīkaraṇavārtika. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1918-30, p. 92 (no. 753 kha).
--C. Ṭīkā by a. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1918-30, p. 92 (no. 757).

Upendradattapāṇḍeya
a modern Sanskrit scholar, (1860-1901); born a. Pavana, D.. Arrah; pupil of Pt. Anantarāma Miśra of Raghavapur, D.. Patna. See Intro. to the text noted below, p.. 3-4.
--Upendravijñānasūtra with Bhāṣya.
Pt.. Princess of Wales Sar. Bha. Texts 73. [Page387-b]

Upendrabhaṭṭa
successor of Padmanābha Bhaṭṭa, predecessor of Rāmacandra Bhaṭṭa, teachers of the Nimbārka school. Bhr. p. 212.

Upendrabhaṭṭa
father of Vātivāla Narasiṁha (a. of C. Bhāvacandrikā on Tattvaprakāśikā of Jayatīrtha). MT. 866.

Upendrabhaṭṭa
--father of Hari(a)pāla(-lita) a. of C. on Gauḍavaho. See Gauḍavaho, Bomb. Skt. an. Prā. Series, verse 788, p. 218. Belonged to Jālandhara. See colophon to Gauḍavadhasāra Ṭīkā.

Upendramiśra
--Bhaiṣajyarasāmṛtasaṁhitā. L. XI. preface p. 4. Oudh. VI. 14.

Upendrayogin
preceptor of Rāmabrahmendrayogin (a. of C. on Laghuyogavāsiṣṭha). MT. 3201.

Upendravijñānasūtra
or Atmavi. sU. sabhASya vedānta. by Upendradatta Pāṇḍeya pupil of Anantarāma Miśra. On a new independent orientation of vedāntic thought; includes a scheme for Sanskrit study.
Pt.. Princess of Wales Sar. Bha. Texts 73.

Upendrasaṃhitā
vaiṣ. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras p. 12 (2 mss.). MD. 5209. 5210 (both inc.). MT. 5674 (inc.).

Upendrasiṃha
See “Skt. an. Pkt. poets known from inscriptions” (D. B. Diskalkar), J. of the Ori. Inst., Baroda. VII. p. 79 (Bhand. No. 1672).

Upendrācārya
Viṣṇu(bhakti)darpaṇa. IO. 2507. [Page388-a.

Upendrācārya
Jain.
--Jinendramālā. Pannalal Bombay V. B. p. 8 (Samskṛta j. m.). Transl. into English, N. Chidambaram Iyer, Madras 1890.

Upendrāśrama
preceptor of Viśvarūpa Bhāratī, a. of C. Arthasandīpikā on the Rāmagītā. C.. IV. 290.

Upeyanāmaviveka
bhakti. called also Nāmārthavivaraṇa. by Upaniṣadbrahmendra alias Rāmacandrendra. On the philosophical significance of the Name of the Lord. Text in Anuṣṭubh Kārikās an. prose C. Q. Guṇatrayaviveka, Rāmataraṅgacandrikā.
Adyar II. p. 195 (a. (Vyākhyā U.). [Adyar I. p. 189b (35 D 58 is same ms.; U. bhaktiviveka, ib. II. p. 195a is wrong entry)]. Baroda 9822 (f) (U). Up. Br. Mutt 15 (U). 155 (with C. U.).
Ed.. Adyar Library Bulletin, 1965.
